articleTitle: Emergency Alert System for Women Safety using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In today's scenario women safety has come out as an important matter of concern, for people and also for law enforcing authority. The number of women harassment and eve-teasing cases has risen by many folds due to the greater disclosure of women in every part of life. Number of physical harassments of women in educational institutions, work places or even in public transports is soaring daily. It has become a societal crisis in many countries. In spite of implementing various regulations on women safety, the numbers are not declining. From several years law enforcement agencies and common people are searching for built-in technologies to control these cases. This work proposes a self-sufficient solution for the women safety. A raspberry pi based location, message and call alert is our novel approach to define one of the solution for women safety.

articleTitle: EVMFFR: Electronic Voting Machine with Fingerprint and Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: An Internet of Things (IoT) based Electronic Voting Machine with Fingerprint and Facial Recognition (EVMFFR) with duplicate voting avoidance is proposed, designed and implemented. The designed EVMFFR system uses dual verification techniques with better results comparing to the existing single verification systems. Using raspberry, fingerprint and facial recognition methods are integrated and used for the identification of voter in the process of election. A biometric template is developed using the rectangular Haar transform during the registration of a new voter which is then used for verification and validation. The features in the developed biometric template is compared with the Eigen vectors of captured biometric of the voters using cascaded machine learning techniques such as Generalized Principal Component Analysis (GPCA) and C-Nearest Neighbor (CNN). The results of the proposed EVMFFR system shows that the integrated design performs better than the existing EVMs. The proposed EVMFFR system performs with an accuracy of more than 90% under day light for facial recognition at comparatively low cost per EVMFFR unit.

articleTitle: Bio-medical Image Denoising using Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Image denoising, in which the original image is reconstructed by eliminating noise from a noise-corrupted version of the original image, is one of the greatest requirements in the image processing field. The sources of noise in image may be in-trinsic (such as sensors) and extrinsic (such as environment) that are often practically unavoidable. One of the crucial initial steps in biomedical image processing and analysis is image denoising as improved visual quality of images may increase the accuracy of medical diagnosis and image preprocessing is required at the input for analytical methods like segmentation and content recognition. Autoencoder is an artificial neural network that is trained in the unsupervised manner to reconstruct its input at the output. This work aims at the development of a denoising convolutional autoencoder which will first generate the encoded lower-dimensional representation of the image and then decodes the image back from the lower-dimensional representation. The denoising autoencoders build corrupted copies of the input images by adding random noise and then attempt to eliminate the noise from the noisy input to reconstruct the output that is very similar to the original input. Medical images like X-Ray, Magnetic Resonance Imaging(MRI) etc. which are corrupted by various types of noise like Gaussian noise, Rician noise etc. are denoised using the convolutional denoising autoencoder and their denoising efficiency is measured using the Structural Similarity Index Measure(SSIM) parameter of both the noisy image and the denoised image compared to the original noise free image and the Peak Signal to Noise Ratio(PSNR) of the denoised image with the noise free image as reference.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Home Automation for Differently Challenged and Elderly People Using Gesture and Voice Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: A Home Automation system provides access to household appliances and is beneficial to Differently challenged and Elde rly people, who have problems with locomotion. It is proven that a Home Automation system makes the disabled and the elderly people independent and makes their lives easier and more standardized. A glove-based Home Automation system is implemented using the method of gesture recognition. Patients operate the appliances by processing the simple hand gestures made by wearing the glove. The caretaker controls the appliances via Google Assistant and Mobile Application. Along with it, they can vie w the current status of the de vice s and time and date of the previous activity made by the patient. Thus, the system is efficient, cost effective and energy conserving.

articleTitle: A Survey on Deepfake Video Detection Techniques Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Deep learning is an effective technology that has been widely used in different ways. ‘DeepFake’ videos are generated using deep learning technology called generative adversarial network where the videos are created with swaped faces in a video, altered facial expressions, change of gender, creation of fake video content and altered facial features. Fake videos are used in the situations like extortion of money, terrorism events or create political agitation. The deepfake technologies are used for positive purposes, such as film-making and virtual reality. The good quality results from deepfakes are very hard to recognised with people eyes. Many deep learning techniques are built to detect deepfake content in images and videos. A comparative study of the performance of various deepfake videos detection models in the deep learning is preseted in this paper. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models include ResNet, VGG16, Efficientnet etc.. Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model includes Long Short-Term Memory LSTM.

articleTitle: Paddy Pest Classification Using Deep Learning Based Features
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The agricultural sector has immense potential in day to day world to improve the requirements and supplies of healthy and nutritious food. Insect pest attacks are the major threats faced by farmers during cultivation and so pest identification is of utter importance in terms of productivity and quality. Pest identification is a difficult task for farmers and it creates severe damage to the yield of crops as well as degradation in the quality of the products. The insect pest attack should also be recognized in the initial state of invasion to avoid spreading. Conventional methods such as naked-eye detection are nonefficient and time-consuming and are difficult in large crop cultivation. This project aims in developing an automated pest classification system using deep learning strategies. Input data is augmented and preprocessed using histogram equalization. Deep learning is used for feature extraction and features are provided to conventional classifiers such as Support Vector Machine(SVM), Naive Bayes(NB), Random Forest(RF), and Logistic Regression(LR). SVM has achieved a better classification accuracy of 97% compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Speaker Diarization Using BiLSTM and BiGRU with Self-Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Speaker diarization is splitting an audio stream into segments based on speaker turns and clustering the segments according to speaker identity by using the speaker characteristics. This paper aims to devise techniques based on bidirectional Long Short Term Memory Units and Gated-Recurrent Units with self-attention for speaker segmentation in a speaker diarization system. Self-attention, also called intra-attention, is an attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence to compute a representation of the same sequence. Experiments were conducted on the Augmented Multi-party Interaction (AMI) Meeting Corpus, a popular speech recognition dataset. The results show the potential of BiLSTM sequential processing with attention to the speaker diarization process.

articleTitle: Classification of Indian Classical Music Ragas using Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: A Raga is a melodic framework of a certain structure of notes. The Ragas of Indian classical music are roughly divided into 10 divisions by V.N. Bhatkhande based on certain rules and specific melodic styles. This is known as the traditional ’ Thaat’ system. This study aims at grouping Ragas using graph clustering methods and compare the results with the traditional methods of classification. This classification is based on the similarity between ragas on basis of 35 parameters based on the presence and absence of notes and characteristic notes. In this study, graphs are classified with two methods. One of them is a community detection algorithm using mixture models. The other method is based on classification using the nearest neighbour where traditional group members are selected as the classification criterion. In this study, the aim is not classifying music into ragas, on which a lot of research has been previously done, but classifying ragas themselves into groups. Our results match well with the traditional methods of classification.

articleTitle: Symbolic Domain Music Generation System Based on LSTM Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: With the rapid advancement in artificial intelligence, the deep learning technique has changed its application domain from mere classification task to more of generative task. As music is an art of systematizing sounds, this sequential nature of music can be utilized by deep learning techniques like Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) to generate music. This work emphasizes on LSTM based neural network architecture for generation of music and evaluating how we perceive the generated music. The model is trained on a Classical Piano dataset and implemented using Keras deep learning library. The Mean Opinion Score is used to evaluate the quality of the music generated by the proposed model. The result shows that the proposed model was able to create listenable compositions adhering to human aesthetics.

articleTitle: ANFIS Based Fault Locator for STATCOM Compensated Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Fault location in the presence of compensating devices is difficult in Power systems. In this paper, an ANFIS-based fault location method that utilizes the sequence impedance is presented for a STATCOM compensated system. Here the magnitudes and angles of positive and negative sequence impedance are used to train an ANFIs-based system. By altering the fault distance, several fault scenarios are created. The voltage and current from the single end are measured and the corresponding impedance values are fed to the ANFIS network. The results obtained are reasonably accurate for the application of long lines compensated using FACTS devices.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Metaheuristic Techniques in Combined Economic Emission Dispatch considering VPL effect for Dynamic System
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In past two decades solution to the Dynamic Economic Load Dispatch (DELD) problem considering emission and transmission losses along with Valve Point Loading (VPL) effect has been investigated by researchers using several meta-heuristic techniques. Numerical techniques such as lambda iteration method, dynamic programming etc. have been unable to solve the ELD problem with VPL effect. This paper presents a systematic performance evaluation of meta-heuristic techniques named as Particle Swarm Optimization and the Genetic Algorithm for combined economic emission dispatch problem considering Valve Point Loading (VPL) to meet 24 hr. load profile on IEEE 9 bus test case with 3 generator units.

articleTitle: Battery Monitoring Based Charge Sharing Scheme for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The demand for Electric vehicles (EV) have risen over the last decade, as the researchers are motivated towards a solution for ever-deteriorating conventional fuels and maintaining emission rates. Charging time of battery and availability of charging stations pose the main hurdle in popularizing EV among public. Proper scheduling of EV charging can also be used to shape the load curves in the grid. In the absence of enough number of charging stations, other approaches like vehicle to vehicle <tex>$(\mathbf{V}2\mathbf{V})$</tex> charging can be adopted. In a common place like an office complex, the SOC and charging requirements of available vehicle batteries are different. A modified bidirectional dc-dc converter which works on the proposed charging algorithm facilitates the charge transfer. This paper presents a scheduling strategy for charge sharing between vehicles using <tex>$\mathbf{V}2\mathbf{V}$</tex> method.

articleTitle: Speed Tracking Performance of PMSM Using Sliding Mode and Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) are emerging as one of the most important categories of AC machine drives. Therefore, different control methods are used for speed control of PMSM. In this paper, sliding mode and Extended state observer (ESO) are used to improve the speed control of the PMSM drive system. A sliding mode controller is employed in the outer speed control loop for tracking the speed of PMSM. Load torque disturbance is estimated using ESO. Performance evaluation of the sliding mode controller with ESO is compared with the conventional speed controller using PI. Better speed tracking accuracy is obtained for sliding mode controller than conventional PI controller

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In most health related industry, large types of data are frequently generated. Machine learning algorithms help to check risk for heart disease from person's data. Analysing ECG signal at initial stage helps to detect and prevent heart disease. Machine learning algorithms like KNN, RF, SVM and DT are used to make use of tremendous data to predict disease earlier. From the classification results KNN algorithm best predicted the disease with an accuracy of 96%. Then the model is deployed as a web application to make available it to users. By using the model mortality rate due to heart disease can be reduced by providing an option to get better treatment as early as possible.

articleTitle: Detection of Breast Cancer from Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Breast cancer is the second leading cause of death after lung cancer, and breast cancer accounts for around 30 per cent of newly diagnosed cancer cases. Since manually detecting a cancer cell is time-consuming and prone to error, computer-assisted processes are used to get better results than manual pathological detection systems. Breast cancer is detected via Mammography, MRI scans, CT scans, ultrasounds, and nuclear imaging, but none of these guarantee a 100 per cent accurate diagnosis. For tumor detection, a histopathology test is performed to detect invasive cancer cells using HE stained tissues. However, intra-observer variation, numerous appearances of cancer cells or tissues, and the same hyperchromatic highlighted cells make identification challenging. Deep learning algorithms can be used to solve these issues. Deep learning uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract information before classifying them with a fully connected network. Deep learning is widely used in the field of medical imaging, and it does not require prior knowledge in a related discipline. The purpose of this automatic retrieval approach appears to have practical utility in the field of imaging for diagnostic imaging professionals in determining whether a tumour is benign or malignant in nature. The objectives of the project include the following: 1. Learn about different deep learning methods used in analysis of histopathological images for medical diagnosis. 2. Detect breast cancer from histopathological images using deep learning. 3. Classify and identify different types of cancerous cell using the algorithm. 4. Comparing the method with other existing methods and analyse the performance.

articleTitle: A metamaterial loaded substrate integrated waveguide antenna for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) antenna is a planar form of conventional waveguide antenna. Initially, an SIW transmission line is designed utilizing the Rogers RT/ Duroid 5880 substrate with a dielectric constant of 2.2, a loss tangent of 0.0009 and the dimensions being 40 × 16 × 0.8 mm<sup>3</sup>. Secondly, a single slotted SIW antenna is designed with an offset slot etched along the length of proposed structure. The structure is then modified by varying the dimensions and a complementary split ring introduced at the feedline. The performance of the structures is analyzed using ANSYS HFSS version 21. The modified structure is found to resonate at 5.1GHz and 7.4GHz with return loss values of − 30dB and −24dB respectively and the maximum gain provided is 2.4dB and 5.4dB. All the three configurations provide a VSWR value between 1 and 2 and an impedance characteristic of approximately 50Ω.

articleTitle: Symbol-Interferometry for PAPR Reduction of OTFS Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Orthogonal time frequency space modulation (OTFS) suffers with the drawback of high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). In this paper we propose a symbol interferometry (SI) approach to reduce the PAPR. The SI spreads out the information in each symbol onto all other symbols which results in low PAPR. Simulation results indicate that the proposed SI reduce the PAPR significantly without effecting on the bit error rate performance. The results are also compared with the existing normalized μ-law method and obtain improved performance.

articleTitle: Deep Feature Fusion for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) is widely incorporated in many applications such as healthcare, entertainment, virtual reality and robotics. However, practical applicability of FER are still limited as existing models are incapable of exploiting relevant features from the facial expressions. In this work, a deep model for FER is proposed which performs fusion of high and low level features. We have exploited transfer learning through pre-trained ResNet18 network which extract high level features and a shallow convolution block is exploited to extract low level features, then, fusion of these features is performed for classification. We have evaluated performance of the proposed model in terms of classification accuracy on JAFFE, CK+ and MUG datasets. Since, JAFFE and MUG are very small datasets, we have exploited data augmentation to increase their size by applying random geometric transformations. Experiments performed on these datasets indicate that the proposed architecture outperforms several state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Various Topological Software Defined Networks Using Mininet Simulator and Pox Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: An exponential increase in the number of users connected to a network, and the ever-expanding size of networks of various enterprises and agencies has caused the conventional computer network failing to deliver adequate performance. This failure has triggered a paradigm shift to incorporate Software Defined Networks (SDN) in present networks. In this paper, we use the mininet network emulated to analyze software defined networks working on the POX controller. The various topological networks such as bus, star and tree has been configured to analyze the performance of the SDN for different traffic classes.

articleTitle: A Model for Relief Transportation Network in Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Disaster management is an area that requires an effective relief framework to reduce its dangerous impact. The activities in disaster management mainly include four phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, and recovery. The preparedness phase primarily focused on determining the location of facilities during a disaster. We developed a framework and optimization model for relief facility locations in disaster management. The relief camps are located within a safe coverage distance using covering problems. The hubs are located in order to reduce transportation costs. We implemented our model for the flood-prone area of the Idukki district in Thodupuzha, Udumbanchola, and Peermade taluk. The optimized relief transportation network is obtained by solving the mathematical model using Python. As we have been facing a lot of loss of life and health during natural disasters for the past few years, it is essential to locate and set up an effective relief transportation network to implement an emergency supply chain.

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement with Grid Integrated Solar Photovoltaic fed BESS using Unified Power Quality Conditioner
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Integrating renewable energy sources like solar are widely used to scale back energy dependency on conventional power generation method, which in turn causes voltage disturbances resulting in massive economic losses. To avoid these power quality issues unified power quality conditioner (UPQC) can be implemented. The UPQC model is made up of back-to-back series and shunt active power filters (APF) that can manage the load voltage and grid current at the same time using control strategies such as synchronous reference frame (SRF) and instantaneous reactive power theory. The performance of UPQC with solar PV and battery energy storage system (BESS) with respective control techniques is discussed in this research. The system accounts for voltage sag, swells, load current harmonics, and reactive power under nonlinear load.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Model for Acute Kidney Injury Prediction with Novel Kidney Biomarkers
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Background: AKI is a serious complication characterized by poor short- and long-term outcomes in the intensive care unit. An increase in serum creatinine leads to impairment in renal function of the kidney and significantly increases the mortality rate. Early detection of AKI could lead to preventive interventions, therefore machine learning systems can detect AKI before its symptoms and consequences appear. Methods: We used a machine learning technique like boosted ensembles of decision trees along with novel kidney biomarkers to predict AKI using retrospective data extracted from the MIMIC-III dataset. Results: Our proposed algorithm achieved high AUROC for diagnosing and predicting AKI with novel kidney biomarkers. For AKI prediction at the point of onset, the algorithm achieved an AUROC of 0.890 (95 percent confidence interval [CI], 0.867-0.878). Also, our proposed algorithm obtained an AUROC of 0.82 (95 percent CI, 0.792-0.809) for predictions made 12-hours before onset and an AUROC of 0.85 (95 percent confidence interval: 0.785-0.804) for 24-hours predictions. Conclusion: The findings suggest that a machine learning-based AKI prediction tool with biomarkers could provide key prognostic skills for predicting which patients are at risk of AKI, eventually enabling physicians to intercede before kidney injuries occur.

articleTitle: Prediction of Solar Irradiance and Wind Speed using Deep Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Increased penetration of renewable energy resources into power systems has increased the need for the prediction of intermittencies in weather. Intermittencies in solar irradiance and wind speed have adverse effects on the power system. Prediction improves the planning, design, and implementation of the power system. Prediction of these data can be carried out by various methods like Artificial Neural Network (ANN) or Support Vector Machine (SVM). This paper presents a method using Deep Recurrent Neural Network (DRNN). Recurrent neural networks identify the sequential characteristics of data to predict the next likely scenario. The data utilized for training is real data from Ramakkalmedu, India.

articleTitle: Energy aware firefly based sink mobility data routing in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In a sink mobility-based Wireless Sensor Network, the sink node follows a path through the network region, gathering data from neighbouring sensor nodes. Sink mobility reduces the distance between the average source node and the sink, hence conserving energy during network transmission. The Firefly Algorithm (FA) is used to offer a WSN sink mobility technique in this paper. An appropriate sink position saves the most node energy in data transmission. To select the ideal sink site for a cluster, the FA generates a chromosomal population. A network energy consumption model that implements the FA process's fitness evaluation operator is also proposed. The FA model creates a set of suitable sink sites on the trajectory for each cluster. FA-based sink mobility extends network lifetime more than other protocols, according to the research.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of High Speed Optical Communication System using Apodized and Chirped FBG with Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In this paper, a post dispersion compensation system with Apodized and linearly Chirped Fiber Bragg Grating (CFBG) is designed to compensate dispersion accumulated over Single Mode Fiber(SMF) of length 100km. In particular the study focus on various parameter optimization of CFBG at different data rates from 15Gbps to 22Gbps. The designed system is simulated using OptiSystem12.0 simulator. The performance of tanh apodized and linearly chirped FBG is evaluated on account of eye-diagram, BER and Q-Factor of the received signal. It is observed that the proposed system enhance the performance of high speed long haul optical fiber communication system with the advantage of using a single optimized CFBG for dispersion compensation. The maximum Q-Factor and minimum BER achieved at data rates from 15Gbps to 22Gbps implies that the model offers efficient and finest solution to dispersion compensation in high speed optical communication systems.

articleTitle: Wind Energy and Pumped Hydro Storage Integrated Power System Risk Analysis using VaR and CVaR
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Due to the environment friendly behavior, wind energy is widely used for fulfilling the current increasing demand of electricity. With this scenario, appropriate corrective action needs to be taken; otherwise system may be in risk condition. This paper presents the analysis of economic risk of a wind power and pumped hydro storage (PHS) integrated power system. Conditional value at risk (CVaR) and value at risk (VaR) with different confidence level such as 95% and 99% are considered as risk assessment tool. Based on the MVA flow of the line obtaining from OPF solution, VaR and CVaR are calculated in this paper. Sequential quadratic programming (SQP) is used for OPF solution. The modified IEEE-30 bus system along with 24 hour load scaling factor is considered for result analysis purpose. Artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm is used to validate the results obtained from SQP approach.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Cuckoo Search on Short Term Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The cuckoo search is used for resolving various optimization problems and is one of the most effective nature-inspired algorithms. The Xintai power plant with back propagation neural network is used for short-term load forecasting. The backpropagation limitation is solved via the cuckoo search technique. The Gamma probability distribution function cuckoo search is utilized. The Gamma cuckoo search has a mean average percentage error of 0.02 %, while the Pareto cuckoo search has a mean average percentage error of 0.15%. These results are also representing the percentage of accuracy for load forecasting. This modified cuckoo search method produces good results in the expected load, which is essential.

articleTitle: Modelling of Passivity based Controller for Buck Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: DC-DC converters find applications in various control problems and the field of renewable energy, such as photo-voltaic (PV) generation. Affected due to partial shading, the input voltage profile of the converter can vary over a broad range. In this paper, a nonlinear control rule for buck-boost converters with broad variations in input supply voltage was developed utilising a passivity-based control method and a hamiltonian system perspective to obtain precise dynamic and steady-state characteristics. A converter state-space average model was used to gain the passivity-based controller (PBC). The PBC's stability and capacity to follow the fluctuating reference load voltage was tested and compared with the proportional-integral (PI) controller under variable input supply voltage and changing load voltage. The simulation findings reveal that, compared to the PI controller, the PBC has more resilience to disturbances in the input supply voltage and can react and monitor changing load voltage considerably faster. The PBC is straightforward to apply, and the converter will have improved steady and dynamic properties.

articleTitle: A Review on Posture Detection and Correction using Machine learning and Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The evolution of homo-sapiens into the most complex of modern creatures is due to the theory of natural selection. It is believed that chimpanzees evolved into humans over time by changing their posture into an erect formation, hence giving them an edge over other existing animals of that period. This paper covers a variety of similar research studies. Several researchers have carried out studies in the field of postural effects to explore the new dimensions of research in different fields. This paper compiled a study of posture to understand the relationship between an individual's daily posture and how it affects their bone health. This study contributes by conducting a pilot review and analyzes a number of existing researches done on posture detection and correction using machine learning and deep learning approaches, and discovers its challenges and scope for the future, which may give us a better understanding of how to avoid several musculoskeletal diseases among the general population.

articleTitle: Sparse Ramanujan Sequences (SRS) transform based signal denoising
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Sparse Ramanujan sequences (SRS) are very recently introduced sparse sequences derived from Ramanujan sums (RS). RS are integer-valued sequences proposed by famous Indian mathematician S. Ramanujan. They have some attractive properties such as orthogonality and periodicity. SRS also possess similar properties and in addition, these sequence elements contain only values from the set {1, 0, -1}. The transforms based on these sequences are also sparse which approximate signal to a fewer number of coefficients. This sparse approximation has many advantages in several signal processing applications like signal denoising and signal compression. SRS transform-based signal denoising is proposed in this paper. The denoising performance of SRS transform is evaluated using performance metrics like mean square error (MSE) and output signal to noise ratio (SNR) and compared with existing transform-based denoising techniques.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement of Three-Phase Wind Energy Conversion System Under Abnormal Grid Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: To minimize power quality issue, this research presents a grid-connected Wind energy conversion system with an Improved Second-Order Generalised Integrator and an Adaptive Quadrature Signal Generator ((ISOGI-AQSG) based control technique. It consists of a permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) attached to a wind turbine and two voltage source converters connected back to back with a shared DC link. To enhance wind power generation (WPG) maximum power point tracking based on Perturbation and observation (P&O) algorithm is employed to obtain crest power from Wind energy conversion system (WECS) under a variation of Wind speed and for unity power factor operations, the ISOGI-AQSG based control system is particularly successful. It also help for grid current balancing and harmonics elimination. The proposed technique is validate under abnormal grid condition, along with the changes in wind speeds and nonlinear loads.

articleTitle: Facility allocation for rakes at a railway terminus
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: An important problem in railway operations concerns the parking of trains in the terminus during idle time. The incoming passenger rakes need to be allotted to the limited facilities at the railway terminus without violating the precedence, capacity, and schedule constraints. Regular maintenance activities are essential for maintaining assets in good condition to ensure the reliability and safety of the railway system. Manual creation of this schedule is a challenging task. We propose a two-phase heuristic algorithm for the terminus facility allocation of rakes. We demonstrated the implementation of the algorithm using real-time data of a busy terminus in the Central Railway and could generate a feasible parking schedule for rakes arriving at the terminus. This allocation is summarized in the form of facility occupancy charts which serve as a helpful tool for railway planners. This algorithm facilitates automation of the terminus facility allocation planning, which is manually done at present.

articleTitle: Vibration Control of Pipeline Structure using Tuned Mass Damper
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Vibrations in the pipeline cause serious operational and commercial problems. These systems have high resonance frequencies with a high dynamic gain factor due to their inherently low mechanical damping. These systems can respond with large vibration amplitudes when exposed to external turbulence, pressure pulsations, or external forces such as mechanical devices. Tuned Mass Dampers (TMDs) are an excellent way to reduce resonant vibrations. Although TMD is commonly used in civil and mechanical engineering, vibration control is rare in the piping industry. In this paper, TMDs are designed for M-shaped pipe structures after performing modal and harmonic analysis using ANSYS Workbench with and without TMD in the pipe structure.

articleTitle: Contingency Constrained Stochastic UC Decision with Wind Power Generation and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Renewable energy penetration into the power system has increased and will be increasing more in future. Renewables are providing low generation cost and keeping the environment less polluted by cutting the use of fossil fuels. But it's also increasing uncertainties in the power system putting its flexibility and reliability at risk. Energy Storage Systems (ESS) have the power to mitigate these uncertainties. In this paper a generalized ESS is added with stochastic and deterministic wind, contingencies to evaluate Unit Commitment (UC). Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is used for obtaining UC results. Different cases are observed by adding each feature one by one, analyzing the results in every case and comparing them thereafter. UC decisions, active power generation and value of operational costs are comparatively analyzed. Results obtained from deterministic UC and stochastic UC with wind and ESS are also compared. In stochastic UC with wind, contingencies and ESS, a feature of transition probability in wind is also added to generate different wind scenarios. These transitions are between different wind scenarios. It is found from the result that stochastic UC gives more practical and optimal results. This study is investigated on IEEE 30-bus system.

articleTitle: Automated Brain Tumor Segmentation of Magnetic Resonance Flair Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Brain tumor is an abnormal growth or uncontrolled cell division in our brain. There are different imaging modalities like magnetic resonance imaging(MRI), positron emission tomography, computed tomography(CT) etc. for tumor detection. Among these MRI's are most widely used since it gives a clear image of the non-bony part due to its excellent soft tissue contrast. Early and accurate segmentation of tumor tissues from the brain tissues is an important part of cancer diagnosis and treatment. It is typically done manually by an expert radiologist. Since gliomas are heterogeneous in shape and size this analysis is a labor intensive task and the result greatly depends on the experience and knowledge of the radiologist. So there is a need for an automatic segmentation to improve the diagnosis and treatment planning for gliomas. This can be done using convolutional neural networks. The size of the input image to CNN can be reduced by cropping out the region of interest and this can improve the segmentation network performance. The network trained with cropped image can give a prediction accuracy of 88 % whereas network with original image gives a accuracy of 86 % under the same set of hyper parameters. Also the time for training the model with the original image is almost double the time required to train the model with the cropped image.

articleTitle: Development of a Monitoring System for Laboratory Investigation of Slope Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Slope failure is one of the serious issues faced by geotechnical engineers, the mechanism of which are case-specific. Shear strength and rainfall are the two critical parameters that require careful consideration with regard to slope failure risk. A laboratory scale model set-up was developed to assess failure susceptibility in embankment slopes. The material used in this study was silty soil having 15% fine content. Rainfall induced failure mechanism was investigated. Effect of slope angle was studied to arrive at a safe slope in a low permeable soil. A warning system was developed using laser diodes that capture soil movement. It was found that during the event of rainfall, the factor of safety with respect to shear reduced drastically. The warning system could capture the surface movement that occur at any section along the slope. Small-scale experimentation set up developed in the present study has the convenience of adjusting slope geometry, soil properties and failure mechanisms.

articleTitle: Geometric Design of Road Using OpenRoads
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Road crashes are mainly caused by three factors which are humans, roads, and vehicles. Geometric design plays a significant role in every road and it is influential in road alignment. Proper Geometric design will help in reducing road crashes. The reviews say that safety can be increased by increasing the lane width and shoulder width. Also, the crash rates are directly proportional to the curve sharpness. When the geometric design is performed manually, it is very cumbersome, time-consuming, and highly liable to costly errors. In this present study, OpenRoads software is employed for the geometric design of the Puthupally - Manarcad road stretch (about 3.5 km) in the Kottayam district. Project Stretch connects SH-9 at Puthupally and NH- 183 at Manarcad. The design method includes Terrain modeling, Horizontal alignment, Vertical Alignment, Corridor and Template Creation, Superelevation, and Plan and profiles production.

articleTitle: “A approach for Hybrid Security Management in Health Care for Secure Cloud Storage: A Review”
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: A full day's worth of activities can be covered by cloud-based health-care services. All previous Walk abnormality detection methods have focused on the walk association constant. The goal of this research is to use cloud computing to improve the health-care system. To assist the medical community in early detection of a patient's primary organs' health status, allowing for proper treatment, as well as to securely store patient health data in the cloud. The goal of the project is to demonstrate how a sensory system can be used to track a patient's movement invisibly. In recent studies, wireless sensor networks have been employed to structure remote care systems. This, like the cloud, is used to relay physiological signals. Cloud computing and health monitoring are becoming increasingly popular in healthcare. COF-based communication transmission systems are still in operation, despite the fact that safe services are employed to monitor 24 hours a day. Secures services allow for more network flexibility, a larger number of nodes, and a longer transmission range while using less energy. The large number of nodes enables the spread of such systems. Secure wireless networks have recently been put to the test in a variety of settings. The proposed patient monitoring system would benefit medical practitioners in terms of correct diagnosis and treatment, as well as health care providers in terms of illness management. The patient is being watched, and the data transmitted to the computer is being tracked. Signals are sent to the patient's or doctor's monitor.

articleTitle: Design of Reconfigurable Filter Structure Based on FRM for Wideband Channelizer*
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: A reconfigurable FIR bank of filters are essential for digital channelizer in wideband system. FRM is a extensively used method to generate a sharp transition width sub-bands or channels for digital channelizer. The aim of this work is to design multiple non-uniform sharp transition width FIR bank of filters with reduced number of multipliers and group delay for wideband channelizer. The design parameters of the proposed structure are evaluated in an efficient way. The proposed structure is designed based on FRM filters and exponential modulation (EM) technique. The performance of the proposed structure is illustrated with the help of an example. Result shows that the number of multipliers of the proposed structure is less compared to other existing techniques.

articleTitle: Recognition of Underwater Starfishes using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The Great Barrier Reef, located off the coast of Australia, is the world's largest and most magnificent coral reef. It inhabits 1,500 different fish species, 130 kinds of shark species, rays, 400 distinct corals, and a wide range of other aquatic life. Currently the reef is under a major threat. One of the reasons is because of the overabundance of a special type of starfish called crown-of-thorns (or COTS) which consumes corals and thereby has the potential to destroy the underwater ecosystem. The goal of this study is to detect this type of starfish using various Deep Learning models and compare their accuracies to find the best model based on its performance.

articleTitle: Dual Open Square Loop Coupled CPW-Fed Wideband Circularly Polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: This paper presents a low profile, enhanced performance, wideband circularly polarized monopole antenna. The proposed antenna comprises of a rectangular monopole, two open square rings on either side of monopole and an asymmetric ground plane. The asymmetric ground plane along with the square rings helps in achieving wide Impedance bandwidth and Circular Polarization bandwidth. The simulated result exhibits that −10 dB Impedance bandwidth is of 2.8474 GHz in the range of 1.6721 GHz to 4.5194 GHz and 3dB Axial ratio bandwidth of 3.6522 GHz in the range of 1.1615 GHz to 4.8138 GHz.

articleTitle: Human body gesture-controlled gaming application
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Gaming has always held the requirement of peripheral devices such as keyboards, mouse, joystick, etc. But with computer technology evolving every single day, human-body gestures are found to be a potential replacement for the primary accessory of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). In this paper, an idea of a human-body gesture controlled gaming desktop application has been proposed. With a simple web camera, body gestures have been detected and image processing techniques have been performed with the help of mediapipe - a prebuilt computer vision neural network, which enables a user to directly interact with the gaming console and with the use of OpenCV, a library designed to solve computer vision problems and which provides many useful programming functions used for features like face, edge, object detection, etc. So the input images can be processed and communicated with the gaming commands virtually. The activity of the said user is recorded and stored to MongoDB, an open source No-SQL document based database program. With this desktop application, a user can play any of the various games offered on the portal.

articleTitle: Islanding Detection and Transition between Grid Connected and Standalone Mode of a PV Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: An islanding detection and transition between grid connected (GC) and standalone (SA) mode of a photovoltaic (PV) plant is presented. A passive method of islanding detection method is used which senses the voltage, frequency and phase for the detection of islanding. A modified synchronous reference frame (SRF) controller is used in this paper which provides a smooth transition between grid-connected and islanded modes of operation. In order to improve the reliability of the power supply an energy storage device (battery) is used during islanding mode. The effectiveness of the proposed system which is operating in both GC and SA modes is verified using MATLAB simulink.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Negative Conversion Ratios Using Capacitor Topology by Selecting Different Arbitrary Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Negative switched converter (NSC) topology is designed by selecting different arbitrary values to generate maximum negative voltage ratios. NSC can deliver better performance and better switch utilization compared to inductor based negative voltage ratios converter. NSC is designed to perform in dual configuration such as by improving the voltage levels and decreasing the voltage levels using multi phase control techniques. NSC generates 15 different negative voltage ratios using 12 switches and 3 capacitors. The testing model is designed for low voltage rating (0.1 V to 1 V) as input and the output voltage vary from −100 mV to −0.5 V. The designed NSC gives more efficiency and low losses.

Author Keywords: NSC and negative Voltage conversion ratios

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Trading Mechanism in Microgrid using CHIO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Blockchain based microgrid mechanisms can be designed efficiently to provide uninterrupted power supply and to balance load demands dynamically. In this present work, a conceptual design of a microgrid system is proposed in power system modeling. A blockchain based trading mechanism has been implemented on this system. Various optimization algorithms have been used to maximize economic profit. Finally, the Coronavirus Herd Immunity Optimizer (CHIO) algorithm is described to accommodate the impression that arises for the optimal power flow (OPF) and energy capacity. A case study has been provided to authenticate the performance of this method. The result expresses that the present scheme can largely improve the power dispatch and trading system.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis in Kesterite CZGS/CZGSe Quantum Wells towards high-Efficiency Photovoltaic Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Kesterite materials are emerging as a viable candidate for solar cells due to environmental friendliness, low cost and non-toxic absorption. This article investigates multiple quantum well solar cells (MQWSC) using CZGS and CZGSe as barrier and well material. An aspect of inserting quantum wells in the range of (2-50QWs) in Cu-Zn-Ge-S kesterite compounds demon-strates the uniqueness of this research. Electrical properties such as electric field, recombination rate is explored with respect to variation in number of quantum wells. Investigation on optical properties such as EQE, IQE of MQW solar cells again adds a different dimension to explore the device. It is noticed that as the no.of quantum wells increases, the photo-generated current density increases dramatically. A device is optimized to achieve high electrical optical properties as well as efficiency of solar cell. A notable efficiency of 29% could be achieved using 50 quantum wells in CZGS/CZGSe structure.

articleTitle: Covid RayScan
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The year 2020 was an unprecedented time for all, combating COVID, following precautionary measures and finding a cure for the virus was of utmost importance. As the COVID-19 is here to stay, it is imperative to detect it as early as possible. Our web application (COVID RayScan) is a prediction-based Machine Learning application which can be used by technicians, doctors at hospitals to understand a X-ray or CT-Scan and hence quickly detect if a patient suffers from Covid or not. According to NCBI, it takes 17.4 minutes for a doctor to treat every patient and that metric has increased exponentially with increase in COVID. COVID RayScan with the help of Deep Learning CNN Networks like ResNet50,VGG16,Inception and Xception helps a technician to run the X-Ray/CT-Scan image through our web application to get the desired result which in turn saves the doctor's as well as patients time and make the process much more efficient.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Solid-State Switch as Peaking Switch in a Solid-State Marx Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: This paper discusses about the investigations on the performance of solid-state Marx generator with and without peaking circuits. Ten stages monopolar solid-state Marx generator (SSMG) is simulated in MATLAB and the results are validated mathematically. A three-stage prototype of the Marx circuit is implemented to analyse the delay associate with the switch control circuit. The output pulse rise time is compared with and without the peaking circuit. To attain the peaking action the minimum time required to turn-on the peaking switch is much smaller than the required turn on time of an IGBT switch. Fast switching solid-state devices are required to act as a peaking switch to attain both the peak voltage and reduced rise time.

articleTitle: Calotropis (Ark) Fibers based TENG: from Waste Material to Energy Source
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Today”s era is an era of technology and advancements where energy is the main component. Almost all devices are being powered by non-recyclable and non-biocompatible materials-based power sources. Herein, TENG based on natural waste material is proposed which is designed using Calotropis fibers (Ark fibers) and PTFE. These fibers are electropositive as compared to PTFE and produced the voltage of 79V on manual tapping at 4Hz. This arrangement has the capability to generate sufficient power that can run 60 green LEDs. Finally, ac voltage is converted to dc by rectifier and stored energy is used to power small digital wrist watch.

articleTitle: Energy Management System in Residence Using Smart Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: From day to day there is an immense increase of energy consumption in every single residence. As an outcome electricity demand tends to be highest in all circumstances. Therefore, we need an energy management system to reduce the consumption. This paper shows how to control & monitor the appliances by using smart technology. To manage the loads effectively, it is proposed with the help of IoT technology. The methodology is to design a smart controller for load management which is suitable for residence. This smart controller helps the consumer to manage and prioritize the loads based on their needs. This System comprises a controller unit connected with sensors that helps to control and monitor the loads. NodeMCU, a Wi-Fi Module is interfaced with IoT Application Blynk App to manage the load. Rechargeable battery cell or pack is managed by an electronic system called Battery Management System (BMS). Its main purpose is to maintain the battery to work in safe operating conditions by monitoring its state. The aim of the project is to design a BMS prototype which monitors the battery charging from the Solar Panel. The parameters like voltage and current are also to be monitored.

articleTitle: Feature Selection using Improved Slime Mould Algorithm for Classification of Medical Datasets
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Due to the high dimensions of the biological data and presence of irrelevant information, finding relevant information from the medical datasets is a critical issue for the diagnosis of diseases. Hence, feature selection technique is used as a pre-processing stage to find the significant features from the given dataset. Slime Mould Algorithm is an algorithm inspired from the foraging behaviour of the slime mould. An Improved Slime Mould Algorithm (ISMA) is proposed for feature selection and the performance of the ISMA is validated on ten medical datasets. The proposed algorithm provided better results compared to the benchmark algorithms in terms of fitness values, classification accuracies and feature size.

articleTitle: 1-Bit Full Adder Design Using XOR Gates by QCA Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: The growth of electronic industry is possible due to the invention and developments of CMOS (Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor) technology. Due to its small size and compatibility, small sized circuits and devices are constructed. But when the electronic industry starts to grow, the number of transistors on a chip increases rapidly, thereby device density and operation frequency increases much faster, so power dissipation becomes a major concern. Also for the development of small sized devices the channel length of CMOS reduced, which introduces different short channel effects. Under these size considerations, there is a need to shift from CMOS technology. A number of alternatives such as carbon nanotubes, resonant tunneling devices, single electron devices and Quantum dot Cellular Automata (QCA). Among these Quantum dot Cellular Automata is one of the new emergent technology. QCA is a cellular type of design which consumes low power and low area. In this paper full adder is designed using QCA technology. Full adder is one of the important designs in the electronics industry, especially in ALU design. Here the full adder is designed using a 3-input XOR gate as the main block.

articleTitle: Computational study of cooling strategies in a high frequency compact transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: High frequency transformers are electrical devices which are capable of handling high frequency AC supply as per the requirements of a circuit. These are mainly used in switch mode power supply circuits. The recent fast charging requirement of devices like smart phones, electric vehicle chargers and other electronic devices have placed the high frequency transformers more and more in demand. These transformers suffer from losses like core loss, copper loss etc. In the present study, the losses are estimated and are used to perform computations using commercial ANSYS Icepak solver. Use of heat sinks and potting material are studied so as to identify the best possible mode of cooling. This paper aims to identify the thermal distribution in such a high frequency transformer used in a charging circuit and to deduce a cooling technique to keep the transformer under optimal operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Survey on Traffic Sign Classification and Recognition Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: To avoid road accidents and for safe driving, a proper traffic sign recognition and classification is necessary. It is also an important part of intelligent transport systems and driverless vehicles. This article outlines the different ways to recognize and classify traffic signs. Various types of algorithms are used to recognize text-based, shape-based and color-based traffic signs. With the development of Artificial Intelligence, deep learning models are becoming more popular. CNN models are used for both detection and classification. Self-driving cars must learn to obey road signs in order to drive safely and smoothly. A transfer learning-based approach to traffic sign recognition and classification is used to reduce data costs. This survey analyses different machine learning and deep learning based methods for traffic sign recognition. The traffic sign recognition and classifications are applicable in intelligent transport system, driving autonomous vehicle, conducting road surveys, improving road safety and infrastructure.

articleTitle: Hardy Weinberg Principle Automation : A Comparative study of Neural network and Fuzzy based accessibility model for the study of Evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Major diversity in population, heredity, and varied survival rates contribute to evolution in organism populations. A common technique to study evolution in population is to investigate the variation of the population's allele frequencies (genetic frequency) from one generation to the other. In plain terms this means that instead of focusing on two main parental species evolution should be studied by investigating the entire population. The most effective method is to analyze the variation in allele frequency in the first generation of the population and then predict the corresponding variation in the future filial generations. Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium model equations in Ecology and Sustainability are used in general to predict a population's allele frequency in the future. As the population model becomes complicated these ecological equations become too difficult to realize and likewise the prediction of the population of the species for the future generation. For example, considering the re-fragmentation of forest landscape. This paper presents two unique methods that utilizes computational intelligence (CI) techniques to automate the Hardy-Weinberg principle by integrating Engineering and Ecology. The automation is done using two CI techniques, which are the Mamdani Fuzzy Inference System and Back Propagation Theory. The Mamdani FIS is tuned using MATLAB fuzzy inference toolbox. The back propagation training model is deployed using python which utilizes Keras and Tensorflow for predicting evolution. To prove the efficiency of the trained models a standard allele frequency database named “ALFRED” is used.

articleTitle: Respiratory Disease Detection using Depthwise Seperable Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Respiration is the process of converting inhaled oxygen to carbon dioxide by leaving energy as a by-product. Although as scientific as it sounds respiration is the most natural and biological process with a plethora of unpredictable outcomes and diseases. Respiratory diseases originate and spread throughout the pulmonary region of one's body. The diseases are generally very common in patients, but they also depend on climatic and environmental conditions. As of now, respiratory diseases are only being identified after they are spread and affected a vast area of the lungs. And there would be less time for prognosis at the extreme stage. In literature, various methods are proposed for respiratory sound detection and these existing methods are limited in capability of detecting any respiratory disease at an early stage. This paper proposed a new technique to detect the respiratory sound efficiently using a depth-wise separable convolution neural network (DS-CNN). The proposed method accuracy is obtained at 92% and compared with the state of arts.

articleTitle: Omicron Case Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: It's been over two years that the world has been dealing with the novel Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19). It has rocked the world in the face of another major outbreak. Countries have undergone various lockdowns & curfews in their own ways, which certainly has impacted our daily lives. COVID-19 has undergone various mutations till now. It is responsible for the spikes in COVID-19 cases across the world. The latest variant “Omicron”., labeled as B.1.1.529, has been marked as a Variant of Concern by the World Health Organization (WHO). It has been proven to be the most infectious, but less deadly as of now. This paper attempts to propose an analysis and prediction of Omicron daily cases in India using SARIMA & Exponential Smoothing Machine Learning models. Both of these machine learning models are based on the time series forecasting concept and rely on previous data to predict future outcomes.

articleTitle: PID based ANFIS control of Inverted Double Pendulum System
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: This article proposes Proportional-integral-derivative (PID) and Adaptive neuro fuzzy (ANFIS) control strategies for stabilization of highly nonlinear inverted double pendulum. The differential equations of the proposed system were derived using Newton's second law. The results of PID controller has been collected and used for training of ANFIS controller. The study considers a novel ANFIS controller designed using only two membership functions which resolves the issue of rule explosion. The study finally compares results of PID and ANFIS controller in terms of settledown time, stable state error and overshoots responses.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Distributed Compressed Sensing Schemes for Data Aggregation in Low-Power Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Low-power wireless sensor networks (WSNs) consist of a large number of battery-operated sensors deployed over an area for objectives such as monitoring environments, tracking objects, and controlling various industrial operations. The aggregation of the huge amount of data generated from the explosively growing number of sensors is critical and challenging. Optimizing the energy spending and improving the overall lifetime of the network through efficient data aggregation and compression approaches are open problems in low-power WSNs. A major portion of the energy consumption of sensor nodes is contributed by data transmission. Hence, efficient data aggregation schemes are to be deployed to improve the lifetime of the WSNs. This paper evaluates the efficient data aggregation frameworks for low-power WSNs.

articleTitle: Colour Detection And Sorting Of Objects Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Manual sorting is the conventional approach preferred by many medium and small-scale packaging industries. However, considering the visual examination being carried out manually by technicians, the conventional method is laborious, time-consuming, dull, and inconsistent. With the development of society, businesses have become increasingly demanding of businesses for production automation. To address these issues, attempts are being made to develop the design and apply automated techniques, which are desperately needed. As a result, we present a Smart device that uses a TCS3200 colour sensor, NodeMcu, and servo motors that help sort objects based on their colour. This system proposes a method for detecting colour using a colour sensor when an object appears in front of the sensor and after recognition of colour provides a message to the sorter mechanism, which employs a motor to drive the sorting tube towards the appropriate positions and another motor to allow the object to go through the tube. The count of the sorted objects is updated to the ThingSpeak. Hence, a completely automated IoT based detecting and sorting system can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Solar and Fuel-Cell Powered High Gain ZETA Converter for BLDC Driven Water Pump
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: This paper proposes a cost-effective hybrid Photovoltaic (PV)/Fuel-Cell (FC) water pump with a high step-up ZETA converter. This work uses a solar PV array with P&O Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) as the primary power source, with a FC with electrolyzer and hydrogen storage tank as supplementary power source for the BLDC-driven water pumping system. BLDC motors are employed because they are more efficient and perform better than other motors. A single switch high gain ZETA converter is employed as an interface between the PV/FC and the drive. The advantages of this proposal are the elimination of phase current sensors and additional speed control circuitry and can control by variable DC link voltage of inverter. MATLAB Simulink was used for the modelling and analysis of this system.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection: A Survey on Recent Deep Learning Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Plant diseases have a significant impact on the economy and a threat to global food security. Deep learning is an emerging technology and it can be applicable in various domains such as healthcare, finance, agriculture, entertainment and many more. Due to its fast and accurate predictions, many researchers experimented with various deep learning methodologies in agriculture including disease detection, weed detection, leaf classification and soil moisture prediction. Plant disease detection is an important and popular research field due to its quick and precise approaches. This survey provides the recent trends and challenges in deep learning techniques in plant disease detection and thus we hope our survey is resourceful for the new researchers in this field.

articleTitle: Reconfigurble Biquad Filter for Low Power Application
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Now a day's Switched capacitor circuits (SC) are replacing continuous time circuits in signal processing blocks such as Filters and ADCs due to its accuracy and less area. This paper presents a novel design for re-configurable switched capacitor biquad filters based on the order of filter to reduce power from 779.89 μW to 325.77 μW. This design is very much useful for portable applications where power consumption is most critical parameter. In this design we have also implemented a novel Op-amp to further reduce the power consumption. The maximum power consumption in this Op-Amp is around 240 μW. The designed filter is implemented in CADENCE environment in UMC 180nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: A Survey on Trending attacks and the Prevention techniques in Edge Computing based networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In current days, many different types of attacks have been sailing through the market on a daily basis, each with a unique element. Detecting and preventing them is a critical aspect of all techniques. In this point in time, the trending attacks on Edge Computing based also plays a very critical role in the messaging information between the trustable nodes. Edge computing, which is a strategy for computing on the spot where data is received or used, allows IoT data to be captured and processed locally rather than transmitting it to a datacenter or cloud securely becomes a major challenge. When edge computing and traditional clouds are combined, software-defined networking (SDN) can assist bridge the gap. But the disclosure on secure communication becomes a tough task. As a result, the goal of this article is to present an overview of spotting assaults and avoiding them using various approaches, as well as the importance of these methodologies in today's digital world.

articleTitle: Improvement in Voltage Profile of Grid Connected Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: In this work, an electrical network connected to Proton-exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is considered. The voltage profile of the system is enhanced by connecting the fuel cell with the boost converter and an inverter. The traditional PID controller does not to responds to the non-linearities of the system. Hence, PID controller is dynamically tuned by the Improved Squirrel Search Algorithm (ISSA). The whole architecture is developed in SIMULINK. For testing the effectiveness of the proposed model, the transients are given to the system for short duration and the results are then compared. It is observed that the proposed model has improved voltage response during transients along with reduced harmonics. The analysis for the power quality enhancement is confirmed through Total Harmonic Distortion (THD).

Author Keywords: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)

articleTitle: A Review on Quantitative Models and Algorithms for Real-time Railway Rescheduling
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: This paper reviews the various quantitative models and algorithms used for real-time rescheduling of the railway network when an unplanned event, disturbance, or disruption, occurs in the railway network, which makes the initially planned timetable infeasible. Such decisions should be taken in real-time so that the propagation of the delay can be minimized and proper service can be provided to passengers. This area under operations management is actively under study. Various studies shows the implementation of the latest computational techniques and algorithms for the research in the field and their testing and validation against real-world data from multiple railway companies. In solution methods, the models providing a near-optimal solution with fast computational time are preferred over exact solutions, which take a larger computational time. This paper can help the researchers to analyze the methods by which existing models can be enhanced or help develop new models to tackle the problem.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 and Sustainability in Through Life Smart Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: Industry 4.0 plays a pertinent role in enhancing the efficiency, quality, and productivity of sustainable smart manufacturing in through-life. In order to maintain material flow stability and the supply chain sustainability, it is highly germane to identify the major driving forces, barriers as well as risks in the implementation strategy of Industry 4.0. Here comes the impact of change management, risk assessment, and quality control as the transition process involves a copious attribute of disruptions, risks, unexpected events and changes. In this review paper, major challenges and scope for implementing the Fourth Industrial Revolution technologies, sustainability in through-life smart manufacturing and the future scope of research are outlined.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Efficient Stationary Wavelet-Transform for EOG Signal Denoising
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: An efficient wavelet-based architectures are designed and presented during this research paper which may be used to denoising of Electrooculography (EOG) signals. Denoising of electrooculography (EOG) signals is a challenging task as the noise and signal share the same level of frequency spectrum. Electrooculography (EOG) plays a crucial role within the event of ophthalmological diagnosis and human computer interface (HCI) applications. Firstly, EOG signals are obtained from physio net fantasia database. Reducing the noises involved within the EOG signals is difficult because of sharing of same bandwidth for both signal and noise. For this reduction designing the methods of wavelet architectures like db4 in MATLAB software for denoising, as well as Signal to noise (SNR) and Mean Square Error (MSE) that also display the qualities for assessment and also compare with existing proposed methods like db3, db5. After simulation in MATLAB adopt Intel Quartus Standard Edition for Digital Signal Processing (DSP), which is used for engineering modelling and production of the proposed denoising approach with hardware consumption results. For hardware consumption, de-soc cyclone V FPGA series (5CSEMA5F31C6) is used by implementation of designed proposed model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Complex Filter For GNSS Applications Using Opensource Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: This paper presents a first order complex IF filter design for GNSS application. A Complex filter consists of two identical filtering channels for the real and complex parts of the signal and hence the output is taken from the two output channels. For the implementation of first order complex IF filter a single ended and differential output Gm subcircuit has been created using Voltage Controlled Current Source model in Quite Universal Circuit Simulator (QUCS). Frequency response of both single ended and double ended differential complex IF filters has been verified using AC analysis in QUCS. The gain of single ended and differential complex IF filter is 3 dB and 9 dB respectively and has a cut off frequency of 100 MHz. Frequency response of both the circuits has been verified using the Transfer function in Scilab.

articleTitle: Super-resolution of Retinal Fundus Images Using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 Second International Conference on Next Generation Intelligent Systems (ICNGIS)
abstract: It is important to have high-resolution medical images for the early diagnosis of diseases. It became more challenging once the structure is very small as in retinal fundus images. A generative adversarial network (GAN) centered retinal fundus image super resolution system is proposed for the early detection of retinal diseases. The low resolution images are fed as the input to the system and the output obtained will be a high resolution image. The method is tested on standard databases like DRIVE, STARE, etc. The PSNR & SSIM values obtained in the suggested method outperform the state of art methods.

articleTitle: Mental Factor Classification Using Computational Model of Consciousness
